theorems.name: Submission.variation_injective_weighted_area_formula
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (s : Set (Rn n)) (Φ : Rn n → Rn N) (g : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞), MeasurableSet s → (∀ x ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ x) → (∀ x ∈ s, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) → InjOn Φ s → ∫⁻ y in Φ '' s, g y ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in s, ENNReal.ofReal (areaJacobian (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) * g (Φ x) ∂μHE[n]
